idea-plugin.name: Session Attribute Type Confusion Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Flags (TypeB) session.getAttribute("key") / (TypeB) context.getAttribute("key") when every known setAttribute("key", ...) write site for that exact string key, anywhere in the project, stores a value whose static type is genuinely INCOMPATIBLE with TypeB according to the platform's own type system (PsiType.isAssignableFrom) -- a guaranteed ClassCastException at runtime (CWE-843). The Servlet API predates Java 5 generics: getAttribute always returns Object, and this mismatch between what was stored and what the reader expects is a real, documented pattern (Coderanch, Experts Exchange) that only surfaces at runtime otherwise.

First mechanism in this catalog to use REAL type- compatibility checking instead of comparing type names as text. Correlation is by exact string-literal KEY across the whole project, not by call graph or field name -- the write and read sites can be in completely unrelated classes.

Stated honestly: v0.1 only HttpSession/ ServletContext; the key must be an identical string literal on both sides; deliberately conservative when a key has a mix of compatible and incompatible write types (left unflagged rather than risk a false positive). No dedicated Marketplace plugin found for this exact angle.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.

localInspection.displayName: Session/context attribute cast to a genuinely incompatible type
